prerequisites: Fundamentals of Business Administration (first year course)

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a global vision of the strategic planning process and understand its relationship with the mission, values, and objectives pursued by the company.
Know the concept of business strategy and its levels.
Understand the main factors of the business environment and how they influence the different phases of the strategic planning process.
Know and handle environmental analysis techniques and tools.
Identify the different types of company resources and capabilities.
Identify how a competitive advantage is created and sustained.
Understand the relationship between the formulation and evaluation of different strategic alternatives and the main implementation process activities.
Understand the importance of the organizational structure to carry out the business strategy and identify the design parameters.
Know the basic elements of behavior management and the different leadership, motivation, and communication styles that affect the process.

assessment_methods.method: Practical Case (Partial Exam or Final Exam)

assessment_rules: The final grade (100%) will comprise 70% from the TEST, 20% from the PRACTICAL CASE, and 10% from the short questions (5% each). In the test, for each question there are 4 response options and a single correct answer; for each incorrect answer, 1/3 of a point will be deducted, while unanswered questions do not deduct points. A minimum of 4 points out of 10 is required in each part of the final exam to be averaged (on one hand, test and short questions; on the other hand, practical case); otherwise, the grade of the failed part will appear on the transcript. If the average of the partial exam is equal to or greater than 5 out of 10, it is not necessary to take the practical part of the final exam, and only the TEST questionnaire and the 2 short questions will be taken.
